references.text: The ark of the covenant and God's house were in Shiloh during this period, showing that the tribe of Dan set up its own idol worship alongside legitimate worship.
Elkanah went up to Shiloh to worship the Lord, confirming that God's house was in Shiloh at that time.
The ark of the covenant was brought from Shiloh, showing that the Lord's sanctuary was there for a long time.
God refers to Shiloh as the place where he first let his name dwell and warns against idol worship that led to its destruction.
God left the tabernacle in Shiloh because of Israel's sin, which stands in contrast to the illegitimate sanctuary established by the tribe of Dan.
The carved image of Micah mentioned here was originally made by his mother and became the basis for the illegal cult that the tribe of Dan took over.
